Roaring Fork Motor Nature Trail to close 

by AdminSeptember 23, 2026September 23, 2026

Share this:

  • Share on Facebook (Opens in new window) Facebook
  • Share on X (Opens in new window) X
Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 0:45
Instaread

Great Smoky Mountains National Park will temporarily close Roaring Fork Motor Nature Trail from 7 a.m. to 4 p.m. on Sept. 24 to safely complete roadside mowing and other maintenance.  

Subscribe to The SMN Xtra

Updates from the Smoky Mountain News throughout the week.

Roaring Fork Motor Nature Trail is a narrow, single-lane road with steep roadsides in one of the busiest sections of the park.  

The park will temporarily close the road at the Roaring Fork Motor Nature Trail entrance. Visitors can still drive the Cherokee Orchard Road loop and access the trailheads for Old Sugarlands Trail, Rainbow Falls Trail, Trillium Gap Trail, and Twin Creeks Trail.  

Check the park website for up-to-date information on road closures.
